# ChoreChartEasy

> ChoreChartEasy is a free browser-based tool for creating editable, printable chore charts for children ages 3–12. No account is required. One active draft is stored locally in the browser.

Canonical site: https://chorecharteasy.com/
Language: English (US)

## Free tools

- [Printable chore chart maker](https://chorecharteasy.com/): Choose an age group, edit every task, and print on US Letter or A4.
- [Free printable chore chart](https://chorecharteasy.com/printable-chore-chart): Instructions and examples for creating a weekly chart.
- [Chore randomizer](https://chorecharteasy.com/chore-randomizer): Randomly distribute household jobs, then review every assignment.

## Parent guides

- [Chores for 3-year-olds](https://chorecharteasy.com/chores-for-3-year-olds)
- [Chores for 5-year-olds](https://chorecharteasy.com/chores-for-5-year-olds)
- [Chore chart for multiple kids](https://chorecharteasy.com/chore-chart-for-multiple-kids)
- [Morning routine chart for kids](https://chorecharteasy.com/morning-routine-chart-for-kids)

## Product and safety boundaries

- The current chart maker is free and requires no account.
- Chart drafts stay in the current browser; there is no cloud chart storage.
- Chore suggestions are general starting points, not professional child-development or safety advice.
- An adult must review every task for the child's abilities, supervision needs, and home environment.
- No paid product or email interest list is currently offered through the website.
